label: D1 after a rewarded rare a2->S1 transition (reward at S1)
explanation: Fires only at D1, the step where the previous trial reward is shown; never at GO or D2. The strongest activations (top quartile ~91% covered, near-max magnitude) come when the previous trial was a2 that rarely led to S1 and was rewarded. That predicate has dev precision 0.83, recall 0.41, F1 0.55 and mass recall 0.70. It is silent after rewards at S2 (rate ~0). The remaining, weaker activity: (1) low-magnitude firing (about 0.25-0.5 of max) at D1 after common rewarded a1->S1 trials, often growing over runs of rewarded a1 trials; only about 9% of those steps fire, and value or older-history conditions did not isolate them. (2) Very small activations (<0.15 of max) at unrewarded D1 steps after runs of a2->S1 rare trials. Broadening to any reward at S1 raises mass recall to 0.84 but cuts precision to 0.22 (F1 0.32), so the narrower predicate is the one recorded. Uses only observed history.
